newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST-ENSO Q1 PROFIT SEEN AT FIM 351 MLN.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-ENSO Q1 PROFIT SEEN AT FIM 351 MLN.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts
covering Finnish equities showed a 351 million markka median
forecast for Finnish forestry group Enso Oy's first quarter 1997
profit before extraordinary items and tax.
Profit before extras, tax EPS
(FIM million) (markka)
Median 351 1.02
Lowest 258 0.69
Highest 470 1.50
(Profit forecasts by 15 analysts, EPS by 10 analysts).
Enso will shift to quarterly reporting from tertial
reporting; the Q1 report is due on May 20 at 0900/0600 GMT and
the company said it would not issue proforma 1996 figures until
then.
In January-April 1996, Enso posted a 801 million markka
profit after financial items.
In March, Enso said it expected its earnings in 1997 to
match 1996.
The median of forecasts for Enso's full-year 1997 earnings
was 1,750 million markka profit before extraordinary items (mean
1757 million) and the range was 1,440-2,050 million markka.
Enso's full-year 1996 profit after financial items was
1,665 million markka.
Contributors to the survey were AG Private Bankers, Alfred
Berg, Aros Securities, Carnegie Securities, Den Danske Bank,
Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, FSB Securities,
Handelsbanken, Kleinwort Benson, Merita Securities, Morgan
Stanley, Opstock Securities and Williams de Broe.
